subject.title: fix(slack): use endsWith instead of includes for _all_ action_id matching

question: Should Slack continue supporting the shipped `_all_` bulk-row cleanup convention, or should that unsupported special-case be removed entirely?
rationale: Repository history proves the behavior shipped, but no current or historical in-repository producer establishes its intended grammar; automation cannot decide whether externally authored Block Kit messages form a compatibility contract.

options.title: Remove unsupported cleanup
options.body: Delete the bulk-row special-case so confirmation replaces only the selected row and preserves every other authored actions row.

options.title: Preserve and migrate the contract
options.body: Identify the supported producer shape, make production emit a closed marker-and-ID contract, and retain upgrade handling for previously shipped messages.

recommendation.title: Remove unsupported cleanup
recommendation.body: Delete the bulk-row special-case so confirmation replaces only the selected row and preserves every other authored actions row.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the cleanup behavior and owns the strongest history on the Slack block-action implementation where this compatibility decision belongs.
